audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Leviticus / Vayiqra priestly inauguration text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for eighth-day priestly offerings, congregation offerings, Aaron's first service, blessing, glory appearing, and fire from before YHWH.

verses.restored: It happened on eighth day: Moses called Aaron and his sons and elders of Israel.

familiar.text: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;

modern.text: On the eighth day Moses summoned Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel.

original.text: וַיְהִי֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י קָרָ֣א מֹשֶׁ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו וּלְזִקְנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: He said to Aaron, Take for yourself calf, son of herd, for sin/misalignment offering, and ram for burnt offering, complete ones, and bring near before YHWH.

familiar.text: And he said unto Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before the LORD.

modern.text: He said to Aaron, “Take for yourself a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering, both without blemish, and present them before the LORD.

original.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֗ן קַח לְ֠ךָ עֵ֣גֶל בֶּן בָּקָ֧ר לְחַטָּ֛את וְאַ֥יִל לְעֹלָ֖ה תְּמִימִ֑ם וְהַקְרֵ֖ב לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: To children of Israel you shall speak, saying, Take male goat for sin/misalignment offering, and calf and lamb, sons of a year, complete ones, for burnt offering,

familiar.text: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both of the first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;

modern.text: Then speak to the Israelites and say, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering, a calf and a lamb—both a year old and without blemish—for a burnt offering,

original.text: וְאֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תְּדַבֵּ֣ר לֵאמֹ֑ר קְח֤וּ שְׂעִיר עִזִּים֙ לְחַטָּ֔את וְעֵ֨גֶל וָכֶ֧בֶשׂ בְּנֵי שָׁנָ֛ה תְּמִימִ֖ם לְעֹלָֽה

verses.restored: and ox and ram for peace/well-being offerings, to sacrifice before YHWH, and grain offering mixed with oil, for today YHWH appears to you.

familiar.text: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day the LORD will appear unto you.

modern.text: an ox and a ram for a peace offering to sacrifice before the LORD, and a grain offering mixed with oil. For today the LORD will appear to you.’”

original.text: וְשׁ֨וֹר וָאַ֜יִל לִשְׁלָמִ֗ים לִזְבֹּ֨חַ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּמִנְחָ֖ה בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן כִּ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם יְהוָ֖ה נִרְאָ֥ה אֲלֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: They took what Moses commanded to front of tent of meeting, and all congregation drew near and stood before YHWH.

familiar.text: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.

modern.text: So they took what Moses had commanded to the front of the Tent of Meeting, and the whole congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.

original.text: וַיִּקְח֗וּ אֵ֚ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל פְּנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַֽיִּקְרְבוּ֙ כָּל הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה וַיַּֽעַמְד֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Moses said, This is the matter YHWH commanded you to do, and glory of YHWH shall appear to you.

familiar.text: And Moses said, This is the thing which the LORD commanded that ye should do: and the glory of the LORD shall appear unto you.

modern.text: And Moses said, “This is what the LORD has commanded you to do, so that the glory of the LORD may appear to you.”

original.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה זֶ֧ה הַדָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ וְיֵרָ֥א אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם כְּב֥וֹד יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Moses said to Aaron, Draw near to altar and make your sin/misalignment offering and burnt offering, and make atonement/covering for yourself and for people; make offering of people and make atonement/covering for them, as YHWH commanded.

familiar.text: And Moses said unto Aaron, Go unto the altar, and offer thy sin offering, and thy burnt offering, and make an atonement for thyself, and for the people: and offer the offering of the people, and make an atonement for them; as the LORD commanded.

modern.text: Then Moses said to Aaron, “Approach the altar and sacrifice your sin offering and your burnt offering to make atonement for yourself and for the people. And sacrifice the people’s offering to make atonement for them, as the LORD has commanded.”

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֗ן קְרַ֤ב אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ וַעֲשֵׂ֞ה אֶת חַטָּֽאתְךָ֙ וְאֶת עֹ֣לָתֶ֔ךָ וְכַפֵּ֥ר בַּֽעַדְךָ֖ וּבְעַ֣ד הָעָ֑ם וַעֲשֵׂ֞ה אֶת קָרְבַּ֤ן הָעָם֙ וְכַפֵּ֣ר בַּֽעֲדָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Aaron drew near to altar and slaughtered calf of sin/misalignment offering that was for himself.

familiar.text: Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.

modern.text: So Aaron approached the altar and slaughtered the calf as a sin offering for himself.

original.text: וַיִּקְרַ֥ב אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וַיִּשְׁחַ֛ט אֶת עֵ֥גֶל הַחַטָּ֖את אֲשֶׁר לֽוֹ

modern.text: The sons of Aaron brought the blood to him, and he dipped his finger in the blood and applied it to the horns of the altar. And he poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

original.text: וַ֠יַּקְרִבוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֣ן אֶת הַדָּם֮ אֵלָיו֒ וַיִּטְבֹּ֤ל אֶצְבָּעוֹ֙ בַּדָּ֔ם וַיִּתֵּ֖ן עַל קַרְנ֣וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְאֶת הַדָּ֣ם יָצַ֔ק אֶל יְס֖וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ

modern.text: On the altar he burned the fat, the kidneys, and the lobe of the liver from the sin offering, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

original.text: וַיָּבֹ֨א מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹן֙ אֶל אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וַיֵּ֣צְא֔וּ וַֽיְבָרֲכ֖וּ אֶת הָעָ֑ם וַיֵּרָ֥א כְבוֹד יְהוָ֖ה אֶל כָּל הָעָֽם

modern.text: Fire came out from the presence of the LORD and consumed the burnt offering and the fat portions on the altar. And when all the people saw it, they shouted for joy and fell facedown.

original.text: וַתֵּ֤צֵא אֵשׁ֙ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַתֹּ֨אכַל֙ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ אֶת הָעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶת הַחֲלָבִ֑ים וַיַּ֤רְא כָּל הָעָם֙ וַיָּרֹ֔נּוּ וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ עַל פְּנֵיהֶֽם

translation_notes: Eighth day follows seven-day ordination and marks priestly service beginning.
Aaron makes covering for himself before the people, preserving accountability of priesthood.
Glory appears after commanded ritual order and blessing.
Fire from before YHWH consumes the offering as acceptance/presence; this sets context for chapter 10's unauthorized fire.
safety_note: The appearance of glory is tied to blessing and commanded service. Do not turn priestly mediation into spiritual superiority; Aaron first needs covering for himself.
